title: Foster a dog
summary: Open your home temporarily to a dog that needs safe placement.
why_it_helps: Opening your home gives a dog a safe place to land while rescue partners work toward longer-term placement. Each foster can also create room for another dog to be helped.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view Stockton Street Dogs’ current foster information and contact options.
The length and needs of a foster placement can vary by dog.
The provider can walk you through current needs and next steps.

title: Transport a dog
summary: Help move a dog to veterinary care, foster placement, or another safe destination.
why_it_helps: Transportation can be the missing link between a dog and veterinary care, foster placement, rescue transfer, or another safe destination.
what_to_expect: Transport needs depend on current rescue activity and may not be available at all times.
Confirm the destination, timing, and any handling instructions before committing.
This action is currently marked unverified in Crossover, so check directly with the provider.

title: Donate dog supplies
summary: Provide food or other currently requested supplies for dogs being served in the field.
why_it_helps: Food and other requested supplies help local rescuers care for dogs being served in the field and reduce the practical burden of ongoing rescue work.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view the provider’s latest information.
Requested items can change, so check what is useful before purchasing or dropping anything off.
Follow the provider’s current instructions for delivery or donation.

title: Support pet-inclusive shelter
summary: Support low-barrier shelter capacity that allows people to remain with companion animals.
why_it_helps: Pet-inclusive shelter capacity removes a major barrier for people who may otherwise remain outside rather than separate from a companion animal.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view St. Mary’s current programs and support options.
Support may contribute to shelter, case management, and housing pathways rather than a single pet-specific activity.
Check the provider’s latest information before deciding how to help.

title: Donate pet supplies
summary: Provide crates, food, bedding, leashes, or other currently requested pet-support items.
why_it_helps: Crates, food, bedding, leashes, and other requested items can help people keep companion animals safe while local organizations work on shelter and placement needs.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to check the provider’s latest requested items.
Wishlists can change, so confirm what is currently useful.
Follow the provider’s current donation or drop-off instructions.

title: Help with food distribution
summary: Volunteer with packing, loading, setup, or neighborhood distribution when help is requested.
why_it_helps: Packing, loading, setup, and neighborhood distribution help turn donated food into meals and groceries that actually reach people.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view Bread of Life’s current volunteer opportunities.
Tasks and schedules can vary by distribution day and current need.
Confirm the latest shift details directly with the provider.

title: Donate food or supplies
summary: Contribute currently requested food, storage, or distribution supplies.
why_it_helps: Useful food, storage, and distribution supplies strengthen the system that moves groceries into the community.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to see Bread of Life’s current donation information.
Needs can change, especially for perishable food and storage-related items.
Coordinate with the provider before making a large or unusual donation.

title: Adopt a dog
summary: Give an available dog a permanent home and create space for another animal to move through the local rescue and shelter system.
why_it_helps: Adoption gives one dog a permanent home while creating space for another animal to move through the local rescue and shelter system.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view current adoption information.
Available dogs and adoption requirements can change.
The provider can explain the process and help determine whether a particular dog is a good fit.

title: Take a shelter dog out
summary: Give a Stockton shelter dog time outside the shelter, community exposure, and a better chance to meet a foster or adopter.
source_label: Hard Luck AWA / Stockton Animal Services
why_it_helps: A few hours outside the shelter can reduce stress, create community visibility, and help a dog connect with potential fosters or adopters.
provider_label: Stockton Animal Services · Hard Luck Animal Welfare Advocates
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover and view the provider’s latest instructions, availability, and next steps.
Outings are usually a few hours.
Someone will walk you through the details and help you feel ready.

title: Volunteer with Stockton Streetdogs
summary: Join the organization's volunteer program supporting street outreach, dog care, rescue, and placement work.
why_it_helps: Volunteer help expands the people available for outreach, dog care, rescue, transportation, and placement work.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view Stockton Street Dogs’ current volunteer information.
Roles can vary with current rescue needs.
Contact the provider for current opportunities and expectations.

title: Support cold-storage capacity
summary: Help Bread of Life expand the storage and distribution capacity needed to accept large perishable-food donations.
why_it_helps: More cold-storage capacity can allow Bread of Life to accept and distribute larger perishable-food donations instead of losing food for lack of storage.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view Bread of Life’s current support options.
This is infrastructure support rather than a one-time volunteer shift.
Check the latest provider information before contributing.

title: Support Ready To Work
summary: Support transitional housing, case management, paid work, training, and permanent-housing pathways for men rebuilding after homelessness or incarceration.
why_it_helps: Support helps sustain transitional housing, case management, paid work, training, and pathways toward permanent housing for people rebuilding after homelessness or incarceration.
what_to_expect: You’ll leave Crossover to view Ready To Work San Joaquin’s current donation information.
